expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The agent states: 'Fresh retry keys could charge members twice. payments.md documents that this exact change caused 41 duplicate charges in 2024 because a timeout can follow a successful charge.' and asks for clarification before making the change, leaving the code unchanged — raising the incident and withholding the change pending confirmation.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step 10; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back members charged twice when a timed-out attempt had already
charged the card, as in 2024.
expectations.evidence: Agent left the code unchanged and warned: 'Fresh retry keys could charge members twice... documents that this exact change caused 41 duplicate charges in 2024 because a timeout can follow a successful charge.' and asked before proceeding: 'I've left the code unchanged pending clarification.'
